subject: wizardBookshelf
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: wizard's bookshelf with tomes, scrolls, orbs and candles.
Style: high-fantasy anime.
reasoning:
Looking at the renders, the front view works well with the gilt pediment, emblem, and shelf contents reading clearly against the starry backdrop. The back view is a problem though — it's just a flat dark slab with no detail, so I need to add some decoration to that back panel.

Checking the three-quarter view, I notice the gold box meant to frame the rune plane on the side is actually positioned in front of the runes themselves, completely hiding them instead of bordering them. I'll fix this by replacing the solid gold slab with a thin frame, placing a dark panel behind, and setting the runes plane just in front so they're visible with the gold acting as a proper border.

Looking at the top view, the crescent finial atop the spire reads as edge-on rather than facing forward, since its extrusion axis is oriented wrong — I need to rotate it so the crescent opening faces the front (+x direction) properly instead of sideways.

Checking crown height reaches the peak correctly, and confirming the crescent's thickness orientation reads properly from the front using the x-axis fix. Composition otherwise looks fine — dais, floor props, book pile, and lamp posts are positioned well — just need to verify the front-view shadow next.

Also noticing the stars are edge-on from the front since they default to the z-y plane with thickness along x, same issue as the crescent — both the crown trim stars and hanging stars need the x:[1,0,0] fix to face the viewer properly.

For the back panel, I'm adding visual interest with a gold-bordered rune circle plane plus a stretched sky texture, mirrored since it's facing -z, sized to roughly match the original aspect ratio.

I'll apply the same emissive full-color glow at 0.6 strength for the back sky texture since it's cheap to do, and fix the cabinet back plane position slightly (-0.2115 instead of -0.2105) to avoid z-fighting with the box. Then I need to work through my edit list: fixing the star helper's x/y orientation parameters, adjusting the crescent, correcting the side rune panels, and finishing the back decor — starting with adding explicit x and y axis vectors to the star glow/extrude call so the geometry orients correctly.

Now I'm adding the same x/y axis fix to the crescent's extrude call, then redesigning the side rune panel: swapping in a navy base box with gold frame bars along the top, bottom, and sides to properly border the rune texture plane.

I need to check that pillar geometry doesn't clip into the rune panel — narrowing the panel depth to 0.3 with runes 0.26 wide keeps the frame within ±0.157, clear of the pillar's radius overlap zone.

I'm locating a unique insertion point by replacing the "// crown" comment line with a new back-panel dressing block plus the original crown line, adding a glowing plane behind the cabinet for visual depth.

Adding gold frame bars...

Adding two stars near the back with symmetric extrusion so depth doesn't matter, and keeping rune planes mirrored since the text orientation won't be noticeable from behind. Setting glow strength for runes to 1 and calling the emblem layout done, with maybe a small gold arc lower down if needed.
